requests.reply: {"translations": ["Seoyoon, are you still at work?", "Yeah ㅠㅠ The meeting isn't ending. Jiu, have you left work?", "I just left. But did the contract go well?"]}
{"translations": ["Yeah, I signed the papers yesterday. Now it's really over", "Heol, there are only three days left", "I know ㅠㅠ There's so much to do"]}

{"translations": ["Did you call a full-service moving company?", "No lol, semi-packaging. I'm moving on Saturday, but I have to pack the stuff myself", "What about the cat? It's going to be chaos on moving day"]}

{"translations": ["I'm leaving Bori at a pet hotel on Saturday. They asked for an English name on the reservation form, so I wrote Barleyㅋㅋ", "ㅋㅋㅋㅋ Was Bori male or female? I always get confused", "She's female. She's three years old but still shy with strangers"]}

{"translations": ["Take some rest on Sunday after the move is done. I want to see Bori too ㅋㅋ Want to grab brunch?", "Sounds good! Hyejin unnie says she's coming to help organize on Sunday", "Oh, nice. Then Bori will be home that day too?"]}

{"translations": ["Yeah, my brother said he'll drop Bori off on Sunday morning", "That's a relief. Should we invite Subin too? ◆", "I asked, but Subin said he can't come on Sunday. He said he has a prior engagement"]}

{"translations": ["That's a shame. Oh, how do you write the new hire Chaeyul's English name? I need to send a calendar invite", "She said to use Chaeyul. Not 'Chaeyool' ㅋㅋ", "Okay. What are you going to do about the sofa? Bori used to sleep there every day"]}

{"translations": ["I posted it on Karrot and got a message right away. We agreed to meet for a direct transaction tomorrow evening.", "Oh, that was fast. Seoyoon, you really cherished that sofa.", "I know ㅠㅠ But my new house is small, so I have no choice"]}

{"translations": ["Did you get the deposit back from your old house? The landlady was quite strict", "Not yetㅠㅠ She told me to clean properly, so I have to wipe everything down before Sunday", "Heol, Sunday is a day off. Let's make Chaeyul do itㅋㅋ"]}

{"translations": ["Right. They said they'll return the deposit immediately after the inspection is done", "My brother used to work at a moving company. Should I ask him for some tips?", "Oh really? Does he still do it?"]}

{"translations": ["No, he quit last year and is running a cafe now. But he'll give you some tips", "Thanks lol Jiu, did you also send the Monday meeting invite to Chaeyul?", "Yeah, I just sent it. By the way, is Bori okay with riding in the car?"]}
{"translations": ["She runs away as soon as she sees the carrier lol I'll have to bribe her with snacks"]}
